newsitem.title: UK: Smiths Industries squeezed to record high.
newsitem.headline: Smiths Industries squeezed to record high.

text.p: Shares in Smiths Industries were buoyed to record levels on Thursday as the Farnborogh air show was drawing to a close and amid a general shortage of stock.
By 1120 GMT, the shares had been squeezed up 5p to 777-1/2p surpassing the previous record close at 775p. The stock has risen 13p in the last two days but trading volumes are thin.

Dealers said this week's Farnborough air show had helped business in aerospace stocks and many market-makers were now running short of stock. British Aerospace was another gainer, adding 11p to 10.11-1/2 stg today.
